name: Nest Mind Art Overseer
purpose: Protect CardNest Season One from duplicate art, visual drift, and low-creativity repetition while preserving canonical metadata.

styleAnchors.frameLanguage: dark teal / deep blue-green with metallic gold
creatureLanguage: recognizable animal inspiration without copying third-party IP
styleAnchors.anchorScope: Visual composition, frame hierarchy, creature appeal, and overall First Flight art direction only. Existing anchor text or icon mistakes are never treated as canonical truth.

knownDefects.issue: Battle class is Support but legacy full-card badge uses the Scout-style wing icon.
knownDefects.requiredFix: Regenerate or correct final card with Support heart-spark class icon before final approval.

knownDefects.issue: Battle class is Warden but legacy full-card badge uses the Scout-style wing icon.
knownDefects.requiredFix: Regenerate or correct final card with Warden guardian-shield class icon before final approval.

uniqueness.title: Distinct Identity
hardRules: No two approved cards may reuse the same production full-card asset.
No two canonical cards may share a card number or permanent id.
A new creature must remain visibly distinguishable from all approved creatures at thumbnail scale.
Exact duplicate production asset hashes are rejected.

continuity.title: CardNest Continuity
hardRules: Canonical name, clan, rarity, battle class and stats must match data/season-one.json.
Final cards follow the First Flight frame hierarchy and CardNest visual language.
Clan identity must remain visually recognizable.
Rarity treatment may escalate visual impact but must not change canonical identity.
No watermarks, generator UI, unrelated card layouts, or third-party franchise copying.
Theme, creature type, battle class, affinity, and rarity are separate concepts and must never be substituted for one another.

User-facing metadata must label Ember, Tide, Bloom, Volt, Mystic, and Shadow as themes; do not call a guardian a Mystic, Ember, Bloom, Tide, Volt, or Shadow creature merely because of its visual theme.
A final battle-class badge must use the iconKey defined for that exact battle class in data/cardnest-taxonomy.json.
Style anchors may contain legacy defects; canonical taxonomy and metadata override any text or icon visible in an anchor image.

creativity.title: Creative Growth
creativity.goal: Every card should add a new visual idea to CardNest without breaking canon or theme.
hardRules: Creativity must not alter canonical card identity or stats.
Creativity must not solve uniqueness by drifting outside the clan theme.
Creativity must remain original and must not imitate protected third-party character designs.
Repeated body plans must gain clearly different silhouette, signature trait, pose, and environmental storytelling.

productionRule: Only approved assets may enter /CardNest/Season One Art/00 Production Ready or production card folders.
